name: Fishing
overview: Scripture reveals fishing as both a literal act and a powerful spiritual metaphor. God granted humanity dominion over fish in creation, highlighting His sovereign design (Genesis 1:28). Jesus transforms the practice into a divine calling when He commissions His followers to become fishers of men, illustrating the mission to gather souls into the kingdom (Matthew 4:19; Matthew 13:47). The miraculous catch after faithful obedience to Christ’s command demonstrates the blessings of trust and obedience in His work (Luke 5:4-6).
